notes.title: Scrapbook Update
notes.notes:
[p]New demo update is out now![/p][p][/p][p]The main new thing we've added this time is scrapbooking. You can now turn the photos you've taken into stickers and arrange them in a customizable scrapbook, along with art stickers and washi tape. [/p][p][/p][p]We're continuing to add to this system and would love to hear your feedback. The long-term plan is allowing players to make books (multiple pages, text etc).  [/p][p][/p][p]We've also squashed a few bugs, and probably made some new ones (｀∀´)Ψ   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44690595/68d0a991dfdd64ffc2bb72952f3b761f31d34c1a.png"][/img][/p][p]In other news, we're excited to be taking part in the Back To School Games Celebration on Steam (August 25 - Sept 1st), which showcases games themed around school, study or creativity. Check it out here:
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025[/url]
[/p]

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Demo Update Notice
notes.notes: [p]Hey friends, in a few days we will be updating our demo (more on that later).[/p][p][/p][p]This update changes which items are included and how certain features work, which unfortunately means old save files will no longer be compatible. Your progress will be wiped.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re sorry for the short notice. [/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to hang on to memories, you’ve got until Sunday June 8th, 11AM NZT (GMT+12) to grab screenshots or footage before everything resets. [/p][p]Some other time zones: [/p][p]United States: Saturday June 7th, 7PM ET (GMT-4)[/p][p]United Kingdom: Sunday, June 8th, 12AM (BST/GMT+1)[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for trying our demo. It’s been lovely watching you explore it and we didn't anticipate some of you would spend so much time in it! (which is why we've been perhaps a bit too nonchalant about data).[/p][p][/p][p]Oh also, this will happen again. On launch we plan to redo the save system (so players can have multiple save files, cloud save etc and we don't have to break data to make changes). At this time demo data will be stable but until then, try to view progress as one of those things where the fact that you could lose it at any time is what makes it special.[/p][p][/p][p]🐟[/p]
